correct.description: Does the answer correctly answer the question (reference-based, §19).

supported.description: Is every factual claim grounded in the retrieved context (§20).

complete.description: Are all facts in the question's relevant docs reflected in the answer (I-012).

unsupported_claims.description: Factual claims not traceable to any provided doc; the numerator of the hallucination rate.

total_factual_claims.description: Denominator for the hallucination rate (§20); 0 yields a 0.0 rate (I-007).

rationale.description: A short justification for the verdict.
